name: Stack Skirrer

bonuses.name: Corrosive Slime
bonuses.text: When armour that isn't Invulnerable is hit by the Skirrer's Slime Glands, roll a d6. On a 6, its AR is permanently reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

abilities.name: Skirring
abilities.text: The Skirrer gains +3 bonus Icons to hit with its first Attack.

mobAbilities.name: Cooperative Hunters
mobAbilities.text: If a Mob initiates a grapple, it gains +2 bonus Icons to the Opposed Strength Test.

note: No Default pool printed (skills.default null). Speed printed '12 Flight', stored 12. Cooperative Hunters is printed under Mob Abilities with no Mob option. Faction imperial: native hive fauna, as the Apocrypha beasts.
